events.title: Iran ceasefire expired - ship struck in Hormuz, Trump threatens Oman
events.source: CNN, RTE, Wikipedia, LifeNews, BigGo Finance, Rappler
events.summary: 60-day US-Iran ceasefire expired Aug 17. Commercial vessel struck in Strait of Hormuz Aug 18. Trump threatened to bomb Oman if it interferes with Hormuz reopening. 230+ oil tankers waiting. Oil surging past 90. Iran firing on vessels trying to transit.
events.change: Ship struck in Hormuz - new attack post-ceasefire expiry. Oil surging past 90.

events.title: 30Y Treasury yield hits 5.33-5.34% - 19-year high (since 2007)
events.summary: 30-year Treasury yield at 5.33-5.34%, highest since 2007. Global bond sell-off: Canada, Japan, Germany also at decade-high yields. CNN reports bond markets getting hammered. Strategists see scope for further selloff.
events.change: CNN confirms bond markets getting hammered. Global scope widening.

events.title: UK gilts flagged as weakest link in global bond sell-off
events.source: deVere Group, Sharecafe, InvestorIdeas, Maravi Post
events.summary: Nigel Green (deVere CEO) warns UK gilts could become weakest link. Collapsed Middle East ceasefire and Hormuz attack push oil above 90. Gilts pulled higher in sympathy with US Treasurys. BOE may raise rates from September. Hedge fund leverage in gilt market flagged.
events.change: ESCALATED from severity 3 to 4. Multiple sources flagging UK gilts as systemic risk point.

events.title: Gold at 4,339-4,397/oz - extreme safe haven, +29.72% YoY
events.summary: Gold trading 4,339-4,397/oz. Aug 19 range expected 4,313-4,441. Record high was 5,602 in Jan 2026. +29.72% YoY. War premium, currency crisis, and bond sell-off driving demand. Analysts say handbrake released.

events.title: Ebola epidemic - deadliest in DRC history, PHEIC declared
events.source: WHO, ECDC, CDC, UN News, Wikipedia
events.summary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in DRC/Uganda. Now deadliest in DRC history per WHO/UN. PHEIC declared May 17. Existing treatments certified for Zaire species, not Bundibugyo. Fastest-growing Ebola outbreak on record.
events.change: UN News confirms deadliest in DRC history. WHO regional office updating.

events.title: Yen intervention failing - USD/JPY at 159.10, half gains erased
events.source: CNBC, Goldman Sachs, TradingEconomics, Vantage Markets, Fortune
events.summary: Historic US-Japan intervention fading. USD/JPY at 159.10, erased half of intervention gains. BOJ held at 1.0% (8-1 vote). Markets speculating Sept/Oct hike. Bessent says Japan should reinforce with fundamentals.
events.change: Stable. Yen holding 159 level, intervention effects fading.

events.title: Oil surging past 90 on Hormuz attack - WTI 84.92, Brent 93.26
events.summary: WTI at 84.92 (+0.49%), Brent at 93.26. Oil surging past 90 on Hormuz ship attack post-ceasefire expiry. LiteFinance range 67.93-106.74. Geopolitical tensions and potential Middle East disruptions driving prices.
events.change: NEW: Oil surging past 90 on Hormuz attack. Energy shock intensifying.
